sources.title: Overdog: measuring AI behaviour that emerges over time
sources.snippet: Overdog · independent research and engineering practice Measuring behaviour that emerges over time. Overdog studies how tool-using AI systems behave across multi-step interactions, rather than judging them from isolated prompts or responses. It develops controlled experiments, statistical methods and inspectable software so that conclusions remain within the evidence.

sources.title: Datalab's Lift: 9B Vision Model for Schema-Valid JSON From PDFs
sources.snippet: Datalab just dropped a 9B open-weights vision model called lift that pulls structured JSON out of PDFs using schemas. On paper, that's the dream: you give it a schema, it reads the PDF, and it gives you JSON that matches your structure.
